name: EPIC 248918047
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 14, 8.6 solar radii and 0.84 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 1,435 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 14, give 0.84 solar masses and 8.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,718 K at its surface.
